definitions.explanation: a container for holding writing instruments such as pencils, pens, and erasers

examples.japanese: {筆箱|ふでばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧ (writing brush) + ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ (box), from the days of brush writing.

TYPES:
- ⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧{筆箱|ふでばこ} (metal pencil case, common with children)
- {布製|ぬのせい}{筆箱|ふでばこ} (fabric pencil case)
- ポーチ{型|がた} (pouch-style)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ペンケース: the same thing; the usual word among older students and adults and in shops, while {筆箱|ふでばこ} sounds more like elementary school
